_comment: Starter registry of public ArcGIS parcel layers, keyed by a short slug.
These endpoints were NOT reachable from the environment this file was written in,
so treat every entry as unverified until you run: npm run lot -- layers --check
Adding your own is the expected workflow. To find a county's layer, search
'<county> <state> parcels ArcGIS REST' or browse the county/state GIS open-data
portal, then copy the FeatureServer/MapServer layer URL (it ends in a number).
